events.label: February 2025 flood
events.note: Heavy rain on 15-16 Feb 2025 caused deadly flash flooding in eastern Kentucky (Pike County and neighbours), and rivers including the Ohio crested over the following week. Snow fell on 19-20 Feb, which can confuse radar water detection.

events.label: April 2025 flood
events.note: Repeated storms on 2-6 Apr 2025 brought record multi-day rainfall to western and central Kentucky. Flooding hit Frankfort, Falmouth and Hopkinsville, and the Ohio River crested along the state's northern border the following week.
